scope: Real running GameLoop and CDP touch input, wall-clock sampling; local fixtures only. No manual controller or Player.update calls.
checks: 80 cases/version; actual running loop; accepted action exactly once; near/far each hit once; both no-target and moving-player projectiles travel >300px and expire; actual player movement; aimed render uses moving snipe, no fixed beam; distant snipe damage after >100ms flight.
limitations: Controlled local monsters and collisions disabled; moving targets can leave fixed aim ray and miss by design; wall-clock screenshots may delay sampling beyond requested100ms, each exact wall and loop time retained. Browser desktop Chromium touch emulation, not physical phone.
